events.name: New York Mets at Tampa Bay Rays

headlines.description: — Freddy Peralta pitched six terrific innings against his former team, Yandy Díaz homered and doubled, and the Tampa Bay Rays beat the New York Mets 6-2 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Freddy Peralta stymies former team and Yandy Díaz powers AL-best Rays to 6-2 win over Mets

events.name: San Diego Padres at Cincinnati Reds

headlines.description: — Jose Trevino drove in the go-ahead run with a bases-loaded single in the eighth inning, lifting the Cincinnati Reds to a 4-3 victory over the San Diego Padres on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Trevino singles in go-ahead run in 8th as Reds beat wild-card chasing Padres 4-3

events.name: San Francisco Giants at Pittsburgh Pirates

headlines.description: — Brandon Lowe scored from third when San Francisco third baseman Oseilvis Basabe short-hopped a throw to first with two outs in the bottom of the ninth inning, and the Pittsburgh Pirates beat the Giants 13-12 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pirates survive a wild 13-12 finish as a 9th-inning throwing error seals win over Giants

events.name: Toronto Blue Jays at Cleveland Guardians

headlines.description: — Gavin Williams struck out a career-high 13 and allowed just two singles in seven innings, leading the Cleveland Guardians to a 6-1 win on Tuesday night over the Toronto Blue Jays in a matchup of teams in the thick of the AL wild-card race.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gavin Williams whiffs 13 in 7 innings and leads Guardians to 6-1 win over Blue Jays

headlines.description: — Yohandy Morales homered in his first major league game and Jared Simpson earned the win in relief in his own debut, helping the Washington Nationals beat the Atlanta Braves 9-5 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Yohandy Morales homers and has 3 hits in his debut as the Nationals top the Braves 9-5

events.name: Seattle Mariners at Boston Red Sox

headlines.description: — Lazaro Montes homered in his big league debut, Randy Arozarena hit a three-run homer and Seattle ended a five-game skid with a 9-6 win over the Boston Red Sox on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lazaro Montes has memorable debut with homer, 2 RBIs as Mariners end skid with 9-6 win over Red Sox

headlines.description: — Royce Lewis and Ryan Jeffers hit three-run homers during a 10-run sixth inning for the Minnesota Twins to highlight a 15-2 victory over the skidding
headlines.shortLinkText: Twins hang 10 runs on the Tigers in the 6th inning of a 15-2 win as Lewis, Jeffers hit 3-run homers

events.name: Miami Marlins at Kansas City Royals

headlines.description: — Graham Pauley homered and tripled to drive in four runs, Kyle Stowers also went deep, and the Miami Marlins rolled past the Kansas City Royals 6-3 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Graham Pauley drives in 4 as the Marlins beat the Royals 6-3

headlines.description: — Christian Yelich capped Milwaukee's four-run sixth inning with a tiebreaking two-run homer, helping the Brewers beat the Chicago Cubs 9-4 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Christian Yelich and Joey Ortiz homer as the Brewers beat the Cubs 9-4

headlines.description: — Brandon Nimmo set season highs with four hits and five RBI, Corey Seager scored three times and the Texas Rangers beat the Athletics 8-5 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brandon Nimmo has 4 hits and 5 RBIs as Rangers beat A's 8-5 to close gap on Astros in AL West

events.name: Chicago White Sox at Houston Astros

headlines.description: — Colson Montgomery had two hits and two RBI and Randal Grichuk added a two-run double to lead the Chicago White Sox to a 5-1 win over the Houston Astros on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: The White Sox beat the Astros 5-1 behind Colson Montgomery’s 2 RBIs

headlines.description: — TJ Rumfield broke a seventh-inning tie with a two-run homer and the Colorado Rockies beat the Baltimore Orioles 4-2 on Tuesday night to snap their franchise-record home losing streak at 10 games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rumfield and Amador homer as Rockies stop 10-game home skid with 4-2 win over Orioles

headlines.description: — Spencer Jones homered and drove in three runs, Jazz Chisholm Jr. also went deep and finished with three hits, and the New York Yankees pulled away Tuesday night for a 7-3 victory over the Los Angeles Angels.
headlines.shortLinkText: Spencer Jones and Jazz Chisholm Jr. homer early to back Gerrit Cole in Yankees' 7-3 win over Angels

headlines.description: — Bryce Harper reached base five times, Jesús Luzardo threw 6 2/3 quality innings and the Philadelphia Phillies won their sixth straight game by beating the Arizona Diamondbacks 7-1 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bryce Harper reaches base 5 times, Phillies beat the Diamondbacks 7-1 for 6th straight win

events.name: St. Louis Cardinals at Los Angeles Dodgers

headlines.description: — The St. Louis Cardinals hit five home runs, including a pair by Thomas Saggese and a two-run shot from Home Run Derby champion Jordan Walker, in a 13-8 win over the Los Angeles Dodgers on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Thomas Saggese leads 5-homer outburst in Cardinals' 13-8 win over Dodgers
